name: Indiana Dunes
description: Indiana Dunes National Park is a rare Great Lakes shoreline where dunes meet hardwood forests, wetlands, and prairies. It offers sweeping views of Lake Michigan and a wide range of outdoor recreation.
highlights: Lake Michigan beachfront and dune climbing
Diverse trails through forests, wetlands, and prairie

name: Gateway Arch
description: Gateway Arch National Park preserves the area around the iconic St. Louis landmark and the Mississippi riverfront. The park tells the story of westward expansion and the importance of the river to the nation.
highlights: The Gateway Arch monument and tram ride

name: Mammoth Cave
description: Mammoth Cave National Park is home to the world's longest known cave system. Above ground, the park offers forests, rivers, and scenic trails that make it a unique destination for both cave explorers and hikers.
highlights: Guided cave tours and underground chambers
Rolling forest trails and scenic river valleys

name: Great Smoky Mountains
description: Great Smoky Mountains National Park is one of the most visited parks in the country, known for its misty peaks, old-growth forests, and rich biodiversity. It offers an unforgettable mountain experience in the southern Appalachians.
